tests/fixtures/look-bundle-synthetic.json is SYNTHETIC: three made-up rectangles and made-up values in ENGINE's look-bundle format (ryagram-look, version 1), with the ramp (edges, stops, anchors) copied from ENGINE's real Film 4 bundle so colours behave the same. It is NOT a real film and carries no real data. Real bundles are ENGINE's (ryagram.preview.look.build); Film 4's is 10.8 MB and is never committed. Generated by a one-off script from ENGINE's film4-look-bundle.json.
look-bundle-synthetic-banded.json and .js are the same kind of SYNTHETIC fixture in the engine's BANDED mode (mode "banded": solid colour bands with breaks, no ramp): three made-up rectangles, made-up values, bands chosen by hand. NOT a real film.
look-bars-scene.json and .js are a REAL engine bar-race scene, not synthetic: Ryagram's ryagram.preview.barrules.build on the story tests/fixtures/live_look_bars_story.json (state obesity prevalence, 2011 to 2023, CDC BRFSS, a U.S. Government work in the public domain), the first 2 seconds (60 frames) only, with the light theme's colour table attached by look.bars_with_themes, made with Ryagram main 4b3f5cd6 on 2026-10-30 from the offline cache. The fonts named in it are not shipped, so the preview draws the labels in the page's stand-in font.
look-bundle-synthetic-stream.json and .js are the SYNTHETIC map fixture packed for streaming with look.pack_progressive (a head, one chunk per period, the fonts css): the same made-up data as look-bundle-synthetic.json.
